# Office Access Badges

This page covers badges for the Lisbon office.

## Getting a badge

New employees pick up their badge at the reception desk on floor 3 on their first day. A photo is taken at pickup.

## Visitors

Visitors sign in at reception and must be escorted by their host at all times. Visitor badges are returned at the end of the day.

## Lost badges

A lost badge must be reported to reception immediately so it can be deactivated. Replacing a lost badge costs 25 euros.
